{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders: revenue == 999999.99
internal_test_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Count them
num_internal_test = len(internal_test_orders)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_no_test = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_no_test['revenue'].sum()

print(f'Number of internal test orders: {num_internal_test}')
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test): {total_revenue:,.2f}')"}
